stories.title: Consent Tier Decision Engine (Core Logic)
stories.description: Implement the core decision engine inside ConsentService that enforces two-tier HIPAA consent rules, including gating of identifiable data storage, triggering de-identification for Tier 1, and allowing full persistence only for explicit Tier 2 consent.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Expose consent framework functionality through FastAPI endpoints and integrate with the tool_router to ensure all consent-related actions are validated, routed, and enforced before any downstream tool execution or data persistence.

stories.title: Consent Enforcement Integration Across Services
stories.description: Integrate ConsentService with lead_capture, unknown_question_service, and debug_logger to ensure consistent enforcement of consent tiers across all data entry points, including blocking or transforming data when consent requirements are not met.
